Official document (PDF) · Meeting record S/PV.3157

RESOLUTION 800 (1993)

Adopted by the Security Council at its 3157th meeting, on 8 January 1993

The Security Council,

Having examined the application of the Slovak Republic for admission to the United Nations, 1/

Recommends to the General Assembly that the Slovak Republic be admitted to membership in the United Nations.

1/ S/25046.
